parts.note: a serious, stern look is a grim one
an ace is an expert, a top performer

explanation.surface: A sardonic remark comes from a solemn specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: A twisted facial look of disgust or pain is a wry expression, wry meaning twisted.

indicators.note: 'No' tells us the following letter is to be taken away from the relative

parts.note: a gran is a grandmother, a relative

explanation.surface: A useless family member was in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No-good' reads as one adjective, but 'No' removes G (good) from GRAN.
explanation.definitionFit: To run a business is to manage it, so 'ran' is past tense for was managing.

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A teacher grades a test as part of a class.
explanation.definitionFit: The moral of a story is the lesson it teaches.

clue.text: Name a particular period to stop work

parts.note: to name something is to call it
a day is one particular span of time

explanation.surface: Fixing a set time at which to knock off.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to knock off, deciding that enough has been done for the time being.

clue.text: None of this affects the Rolling Stones

definitions.text: None of this affects the Rolling Stones

parts.words: None of this affects the Rolling Stones
parts.note: the proverb says a rolling stone gathers none of this green plant growth

explanation.surface: Something that seemingly has no effect on the famous rock band.
explanation.walkthrough: The band Rolling Stones is a decoy; the clue rests on the proverb about a rolling stone gathering none.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says a rolling stone gathers no such green growth, so stones that keep rolling stay free of it.

parts.note: to open something is to start it
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: Begin singing out of doors.
explanation.definitionFit: Something held in the open air takes place outdoors, not inside a building.

clue.text: Decade with which number of dwarfs will have connections

parts.note: Snow White had seven dwarfs
ties are bonds or connections

explanation.surface: A decade in which the fairy-tale dwarfs make links with one another.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1970s are a ten-year span, one decade of a century.

clue.text: With continuing success, have jam here?

definitions.meaning: the idiom describes a run of successive wins
literally, jam might be spread on a bread roll

explanation.surface: A lucky streak, or a suggestion of where to spread preserves.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone enjoying a streak of wins, one after another.

definitions.meaning: to ... something behind is not to take it

explanation.surface: An instruction not to use one's vacation days.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers and employees speak of annual leave, meaning authorised time off; to leave a thing is to not take it.

clue.text: Severely criticised cadets' gait when marching around

indicators.note: marching around suggests the letters moving about into a new formation

explanation.surface: Young officers were rebuked for their poor walking style on parade.
explanation.walkthrough: The parade-ground picture hides the device: 'when marching around' is the anagram signal, not part of the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To castigate is to reprimand or scold harshly.

clue.text: At will, any mug can be prepared for soup

indicators.note: preparing, like cooking up, means these letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Any fool, if they like, can make a bowl of soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be prepared' signals that AT WILL ANY MUG is rearranged; mug here means a fool, not a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a spicy curried broth from Anglo-Indian cooking.

indicators.note: sadly implies things have gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone feels very small while brooding unhappily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sadly' signals that I RUMINATE is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Something made on a very small scale is described as little or so tiny.

definitions.meaning: the German cipher machine of the Second World War
Elgar's orchestral work is the Variations on an Original Theme, known by this name

explanation.surface: A war-era device that comes in a few different versions.
explanation.definitionFit: The German coding device of WWII and Elgar's set of orchestral variations share this name, which means a mystery.

clue.text: Shimmer of gold, initially — pay attention

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of gold

parts.note: to listen is to pay attention

explanation.surface: A glint of gold catches the eye: take note.
explanation.definitionFit: To glisten is to sparkle or gleam, as wet surfaces do in light.

clue.text: November in an Italian city: go to bed

indicators.note: in places the November letter within the city name

parts.note: Turin is a city in northern Italy
N is November in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A traveller in Italy in late autumn heads off to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire for the night is an everyday idiom for heading off to sleep.

clue.text: In making these profits, London maybe catches up

parts.note: London is an example of a capital city
to gain on someone is to catch up with them

explanation.surface: London closing the gap while earning money.
explanation.definitionFit: Profits from selling assets for more than was paid are taxed as such in Britain.

parts.note: I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a mage is a magician or sorcerer

explanation.surface: An object of worship comes from an Indian wizard.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved likeness worshipped as a god is a graven image, an idol.

parts.note: to quit something is to abandon it

indicators.note: rear of means take the final letter of house

explanation.surface: Fully deserting the back part of a home.
explanation.definitionFit: In the sense 'quite right', the word means entirely or fully.

clue.text: Curious way leading to the mountains

indicators.note: leading to places the way first, before the mountains

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
a range is a chain of mountains

explanation.surface: An odd road heading up into the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: Something curious is odd or peculiar, unusual enough to arouse interest.

indicators.note: regularly means take every other letter, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Turf being burnt in the stove.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural gas is burned for heating and cooking, so it is a fuel.

indicators.note: in says the name sits within the words need named

explanation.surface: A female who required a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Edna is a female given name, so it stands for a woman.

parts.note: an ad, an advertisement, is a notice
verse is poetry made of stanzas

explanation.surface: A poor review of some poems.
explanation.definitionFit: Adverse conditions are harmful or hostile, working against someone.
